faq.q: What is an AI model photo?
faq.a: It is a photo that shows your clothing or accessory worn by an AI-generated model. You start from one flat product photo and get a styled, on-body image.

faq.q: Which products work on an AI model?
faq.a: Tops, dresses, outerwear, bags and jewelry work well. A clear flat garment or accessory photo gives the best reference.

faq.q: Does the photo prove how clothing fits?
faq.a: No. It shows a styled look, not a measured fitting. Keep verified measurements and a size chart in the listing.

faq.q: Can I choose the model's age or look?
faq.a: Yes. Pick a general adult look that fits your audience. Do not request a real celebrity, and small differences between results are normal.

faq.q: Can I use these photos on my store and social channels?
faq.a: Yes. Use the worn view on a product page or social post, and keep a separate plain product photo for details.

faq.q: How fast can I launch a new collection?
faq.a: Each item moves from a flat photo to a worn look in minutes. You can prepare a whole collection without booking model days.

faq.q: Can the image run in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use. Add any price or offer in your ad editor, not on the image.

faq.q: Do the garment details stay the same?
faq.a: Color and cut are kept from the flat photo, but small print or closure details can shift. Compare each result with the real item.
